data.body: Investigation complete (debug-everything 2026-05-11): Code is already correct. AcliClient.create_issue uses .capitalize() for ticket_type (acli-integration.py:554) and _create_issue_from_json uses _LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA dict for integer priorities (line 324-325). All 34 field-coverage tests pass. The 69/207 type mismatches and 76/207 priority mismatches in Jira are historical residue from before commits fc08619754 and fe3153e5ee on 2026-03-24. Fix needed: one-shot reconciliation script that re-emits EDIT events for stale Jira issues. No current behavioral defect — code is correct for all new tickets.
